messages:
maria-ops: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's cross-region DNS/LB flapping. Root cause chain: regional LB health check flapped -> client resolvers re-resolved aggressively -> registrar TTL + route churn amplified retries. Posting action items, owners, and timelines. Please ack and add any missed tasks.

devon-sre: I'll capture the metrics + replay traces in the incident doc. Noted a consistent spike in application retry_count and TCP retransmits at ~23:12 UTC. Short timeline: initial LB degraded 23:09 -> registrar updates 23:11 -> client re-resolve storm 23:12-23:20.

ashok-net: I can own the TTL/registrar mitigation. Immediate plan: lower authoritative A-record TTL from 300s -> 60s in two canary regions, monitor for 30m, then roll global if stable. I'll open a change PR with staged windows and a rollback plan. ETA: change drafted by EOD, rollout tomorrow 07:00 UTC.

lee-eng: I'll take the routing-shadow rule remediation. Found a legacy shadow rule in infra repo that overrides preferred egress when LB is marked degraded. Small config patch + unit test. Plan: quick canary deploy to us-west, monitor 1h. PR coming up.

paul-net: I'll own registrar contact & escalation. Need quick approval to request a TTL override and to check registrar rate limits. Also will coordinate a temporary emergency ACL with registrar if they can rate-limit queries on their side. Contacting them now.

maria-ops: Consolidated action items:
- TTL canary change (owner: ashok-net) - ETA: draft EOD, rollout tomorrow 07:00 UTC
- Routing-shadow config patch (owner: lee-eng) - ETA: PR in 4hrs, canary deploy after merge
- Registrar escalation & emergency rate check (owner: paul-net) - ETA: initial contact in 1hr
- Metrics + traces replay (owner: devon-sre) - ETA: morning, include seq logs and resolver QPS per region
- Postmortem doc update (owner: maria-ops) - ETA: tomorrow EOD

oncall-bot: Created incident-tracker task: https://tracker.redwood.internal/INC-5189 "DNS re-resolve amplification / LB health cascade" assigned to incident-followup.

devon-sre: From the replay, many clients retried with exponential backoff disabled (older client libs). Short-term mitigation: recommend client-side jitter + a soft retry cap via config. This requires product teams to push a patch.

lee-eng: tagging @product-api to coordinate client runtime change. @paul-net please confirm TLS/cert rotation windows if we lower A-record TTL — want to avoid surprising cert renewals.

paul-net: Lowering A-record TTL won't affect cert rotation windows. If anyone plans to change CNAMEs for cert-managed hostnames, call that out. For A records it's safe for short windows.

ashok-net: I'll include a rollback runbook: set TTL back to 300s + propagation wait; health-check command: `dig +short service.api.redwood.internal A` and verify >90% consistent answers across regions. Also will add a check to our monitoring: authoritative QPS and NXDOMAIN spikes.

maria-ops: Note: this is the third DNS/backoff incident pattern in the last 6 months. Long-term items we should add:
- Registrar provider comparison + failover strategy
- Library/enforcement for client-side backoff/jitter
- Routing precedence review to eliminate shadow rules

devon-sre: Agreed. Propose a 2-week spike for "registrar hardening + client backoff enforcement" to prototype coordinated backoff/route-staggering. Will include cost/ops tradeoffs.

lee-eng: sgtm. I'll draft a short RFC covering canonical routing precedence, shadow-rule elimination, and a small client helper lib for safe re-resolve semantics.

maria-ops: Please ack your items in-thread. We'll run a 15m sync at 11:00 to confirm progress.

ashok-net: ack.

lee-eng: ack. PR draft in 30m.

paul-net: ack, contacting registrar now.

devon-sre: ack, replay notes will be in the incident doc.

maria-ops: Thanks all. I'll update the incident tracker with owners & ETAs. Ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
